SELECT to_char(r.created AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'HH24:MI:SS') AS hora, r.status_code,
       left(regexp_replace(coalesce(r.content, r.error_msg, ''), '[A-Za-z0-9_\-\.]{40,}', '<oculto>', 'g'), 120) AS resposta
FROM net._http_response r
WHERE r.created > now() - interval '12 minutes'
ORDER BY r.created DESC
LIMIT 12
